blocks.text: Molloy and Lawlor (Baltimore, LFF 2023) engage in a witty and moving conversation that explores family history and their latest project, a film about groundbreaking artists Claude Cahun and Marcel Moore. As they analyse this decades-long relationship, they identify parallels between these two artists and their own lives. Act 3 celebrates the power of connection, artistic exploration and the importance of memory to shape our present and future.

blocks.text: Having attended a Hallmark movie workshop, John Wilson applies his learnings to a documentary about concrete, albeit with a dryly funny and deceptively understated tone.
A filmmaker sifts through decades of home movies to understand her father, in this intimate study of what it means to love an addict.
The heir of one of America’s wealthiest families, who has ambitions to rebel against values he now despises, is the subject of Sinéad O’Shea’s compelling documentary portrait.
